 1                                            STIPULATION

 2          Pursuant to Civil Local Rule 6-2 and 7-12, Plaintiffs and Defendants Prosper Funding LLC

 3   and Prosper Marketplace, Inc. (“Prosper”) (collectively the “Parties”) by and through their counsel

 4   of record, hereby stipulate and agree, subject to approval of the Court, as follows:

 5          WHEREAS, on March 30, 2026, Plaintiffs filed a Consolidated Class Action Complaint

 6   against Prosper in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California (Dkt. No. 95);

 7          WHEREAS, on May 11, 2026, the Parties submitted a Joint Stipulation and Proposed Order

 8   permitting Plaintiffs to file an Amended Consolidated Class Action Complaint and providing

 9   Prosper with 60 days to respond (Dkt. No. 99);

10          WHEREAS, on May 12, 2026, the Court entered the Parties’ Joint Stipulation and Proposed

11   Order allowing Plaintiffs to file an Amended Consolidated Class Action Complaint after May 6,

12   2026, and requiring Prosper to answer or otherwise respond 60 days after the filing of said Amended

13   Consolidated Class Action Complaint (Dkt. No. 101);

14          WHEREAS, on May 29, 2026, Plaintiffs filed an Amended Consolidated Class Action

15   Complaint against Prosper in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California (Dkt.

16   No. 103);

17          WHEREAS, on July 14, 2026, the Parties submitted a Joint Stipulation and Proposed Order

18   to extend the time for Prosper to respond to the Amended Consolidated Class Action Complaint by

19   45 days, to September 11, 2026 (Dkt. No. 106);

20          WHEREAS, on July 15, 2026, the Court entered the Parties’ Joint Stipulation and Proposed
21   Order extending Prosper’s time to respond to the Amended Consolidated Class Action Complaint

22   by 45 days, to September 11, 2026 (Dkt. No. 107);

23          WHEREAS, the Parties have agreed to engage a mediator in an attempt to resolve this

24   action, see Declaration of Ali Abugheida (“Abugheida Decl.”) ¶ 6;

25          WHEREAS, the Parties have agreed to mediate before Robert Meyer, Esq. and are currently

26   conferring regarding the scheduling of the mediation, which the Parties anticipate taking place in
27   late 2026 or early 2027 depending on Party and mediator availability, see id.;

28          WHEREAS, the Parties believe a temporary stay of proceedings will promote judicial

 4   but not limited to Defendants’ responsive pleading deadline (September 11, 2026), pending the

 5   outcome of the Parties’ mediation, see Abugheida Decl. ¶ 8; and

 6          NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY STIPULATED AND AGREED, by and among the

12              mediation, advising the Court of the status of the mediation process and whether a

13              continuation of the stay is needed.
